description: Landslides From Space - Koshe Garbage Landslide, Ethiopia (11Th March 2017) is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. On 11th March 2017 a garbage dump collapsed and caused a landslide in Koshe. Nearby buildings were buried and 115 people died. The pre-event acquisition is from 10th March 2017 (Sentinel-2) and the post-event acquisition is from 9th April 2017 (Sentinel-2). Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2017). Coverage: Koshe, Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are Landslide, Garbage dump, Sentinel-2, Koshe, Ethiopia. The repository dates the deposit 2017; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
